tips.text:
Welcome to the table! We each start with 20 Heart. Knock mine to 0 and you win.

You have 1 [b]Spark[/b], the gold orb on your panel. A card's cost is in its gold gem.

Click [b]Kindling Fox[/b], then a green lane.

Each creature attacks [b]straight down its lane[/b].

The badges preview what will happen: [b]→ 1[/b] means 1 damage to my Heart, because the lane across is empty.

Press [b]Attack![/b]

Nice! Creatures usually nap the turn they arrive (that's the [b]zzz[/b]).

But Kindling Fox has [b]Swift[/b], so it can attack right away. Press [b]Attack...[/b]
That's everything you can do this turn. Press [b]End turn[/b] and I'll take mine.

My turn. I get Sparks too, one more every turn.

Going second, I also got a [b]Lucky Penny[/b]: one extra Spark, once. Fair's fair.

See my creature across from yours? Creatures facing each other [b]fight[/b]: both deal their power at the same time, and damage [b]stays[/b].

When you attack, badges tell you how it'll go: [b]KO![/b] you win the fight, [b]trade[/b] both fall, [b]hit[/b] both live, [b]dies[/b] you lose it.
You don't need to block on my turn. Your creatures [b]guard their lane[/b] automatically. An empty lane is an open door to your Heart.
New turn: one more Spark, and they all refill. Unused Sparks don't carry over, so try to spend them every turn.
See the blue ring on my Squire? That's a [b]Shield[/b]. It ignores the first hit, whatever the size. Pop it with something small first.
My Gull has [b]Soar[/b]: it flies over whatever's across from it and hits your Heart. Only Soar or Reach creatures can fight it. Spells work too!
[b]Spark Toss[/b] is a spell. Click it, then click any creature, or my panel on the left to hit my Heart directly.
Lanes full? You can play a creature right on top of one of your own. The old one heads home to make room.
You've got me on the ropes. Finish it!
That's the whole game, really. The rest is choosing lanes and timing. I'll keep quiet unless something new comes up.
